consequence.statement: Any configuration using the 1.20 compatibilityProfile or its associated removed feature flags (ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING, VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT) will be ignored or cause failures after upgrade.
